description: Findings of a covered specification that its rule is known not to reproduce, with the reason. scripts/validate_detector_rules.py reports them as expected instead of failing. A finding listed here gets alert_absent on its baseline, so a patch for it is `unverified` (violation not reproduced), never `repaired`.

misses.reason: the trust-all X509TrustManager and HostnameVerifier are built in UnsafeOkHttpClient, another class; the reported method only uses it, and a rule local to the method cannot see across the call
